notes.title: Golden Marshmallows!
notes.content:
There is now a [b]10% chance[/b] that a marshmallow will be [b]GOLD.[/b] They will [b]drop 10x[/b] more loot than normal marshmallows...

[b]Update Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added [b]10% chance[/b] for Marshmallows to be [b]GOLD[/b]
[*]Fixed [b]Color Selection[/b] when using the cosmetic station
[*]Fixed [b]Color Selection[/b] staying when entering a new level
[*]Fixed [b]Visual Currency[/b] not updating when buying items
[/list]

notes.title: Visual Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed colors not applying in customization
[*]Fixed carts not hurting the player in some areas
[*]Fixed some chests hovering above the ground
[*]Fixed Volleyball sometimes giving the wrong point to the wrong side
[/list]

notes.title: Boss Fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed Tank Boss not rotating properly
[/list]

notes.title: Small Visual Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a delay between the level ending so its not so abrupt
[*] Added Controller button icons to flame customization
[/list]

notes.title: COINS COINS COINS - Small Tweaks
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Increased drops of coins for ALL Bosses
[*] Increased drops of coins for all Enemies
[*] Increased drops of coins for Chests
[*] Fixed random visual issues with levels
[*] Fixed Pause Menu Bug where if you click off of the screen with the mouse and click back it wouldn't allow the controller to work without using the mouse to resume the game
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Small Tweaks
notes.content:
[h2]Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Volleyball Lobby Game! You can play volleyball in the main lobby on the far right past the shop!
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with local multiplayer crown symbols above heads not disappearing
[*] Fixed coin display issues where it wouldn't display the proper amount collected
[*] Fixed coins not working properly with shop
[*] Fixed small visual issues with the "Ninja Town" Level
[*] Fixed parkour visual issue with the "Chocolate Caverns" Level
[*] Fixed local multiplayer bug where the melee button wasn't working after clicking off screen
[*] Made Disco Battle Scores more consistent and easier to gain the [u]"Disco King" achievement[/u]
[*] Modified the kills stat at the end of each level that fixed the [u]"Zen Like" achievement[/u]
[/list]
